subject: NPCカービー
text: Quests are accepted from NPC Kirby in front of the Arcsophia transfer gate on floor 76.

evidence.quote: 76層アークソフィア・転移門前のNPCカービーから受注する。
evidence.translation: Quests are accepted from NPC Kirby in front of the Arcsophia transfer gate on floor 76.

subject: 討伐 quests
text: Hunt quests require just defeating a specified number of particular monsters in the field.

evidence.quote: 討伐 フィールドにいる特定モンスターを指定数倒すだけ。
evidence.translation: Hunt quests require just defeating a specified number of particular monsters in the field.

subject: 採集 quests
text: Gathering quests require gathering the required quantity from gathering points in the field and delivering them.

evidence.quote: 採集 フィールドの採集ポイントから要求数を採集し、納品する。
evidence.translation: Gathering quests require gathering the required quantity from gathering points in the field and delivering them.

subject: 収集 quests
text: Collection quests require delivering the required number of monster drop items.

evidence.quote: 収集 モンスターからのドロップアイテムを要求数納品する。
evidence.translation: Collection quests require delivering the required number of monster drop items.

subject: 採集ポイント
text: Gathering points do not glow unless approached to a certain distance, so search the designated field thoroughly.

evidence.quote: 採集ポイントはある程度近づかないと光らない。指定フィールドをくまなく歩き回って探そう。
evidence.translation: Gathering points do not glow unless approached to a certain distance, so search the designated field thoroughly.

subject: 採集ポイント
text: Gathering points respawn when passing 0 o'clock in-game time, or by area-change autosave then quitting and reloading.

evidence.quote: ゲーム内時間で0時をまたぐか、エリア移動のオートセーブ→一度ゲームを終了しロードでポイント復活。
evidence.translation: Gathering points respawn when passing 0 o'clock in-game time, or by area-change autosave then quitting and reloading.

subject: 換金 items
text: Be careful not to sell items marked for exchange before delivery because they are exchange items.

evidence.quote: [換金]表示のアイテムなので、納品前に売ってしまわないよう注意。
evidence.translation: Be careful not to sell items marked for exchange before delivery because they are exchange items.

subject: some quests
text: Clearing another quest can also be a requirement for accepting some quests.

evidence.quote: また、一部クエストは別クエストのクリアが受注の条件になっていることもある。
evidence.translation: Clearing another quest can also be a requirement for accepting some quests.

subject: quest reporting
text: After completing a report, talk to the NPC once more to check if a new quest has appeared.

evidence.quote: 報告完了後は、もう一度話し掛けて新規クエストが発生していないか確認しよう。
evidence.translation: After completing a report, talk to the NPC once more to check if a new quest has appeared.

subject: frontline NPC side requests
text: Frontline NPCs ask by email for help with leveling, hunting, and item collection.

evidence.quote: このほか、攻略組のNPCからレベル上げや討伐、アイテム収集の手伝いをメールで頼まれる。
evidence.translation: Frontline NPCs ask by email for help with leveling, hunting, and item collection.

subject: frontline NPC side requests
text: An exclamation icon appears overhead, and talking to them or defeating at least 1 monster advances conversation to accept the request.

evidence.quote: 頭上に（！）のアイコンが表示されるので、この状態で話し掛けるか、...戦闘を手伝い1匹でもモンスターを倒すと会話イベントが進行、依頼を正式に受けた状態となる。
evidence.translation: An exclamation icon appears overhead, and talking to them or defeating at least 1 monster advances conversation to accept the request.

subject: frontline NPC side requests
text: For hunts defeat the specified count, or for collection carry requested items, then repeat the action to clear.

evidence.quote: 討伐であれば指定数の撃破後、収集であれば要求されたアイテムを持った状態で、再度上記行動を取るとクリア。
evidence.translation: For hunts defeat the specified count, or for collection carry requested items, then repeat the action to clear.

subject: frontline NPC side requests
text: Moving to another area after clearing delivers a thank-you email, sometimes with attached items like potions.

evidence.quote: クリア後に別エリアに移動するとお礼のメールが届き、ポーション等のアイテムが添付されていることもある。
evidence.translation: Moving to another area after clearing delivers a thank-you email, sometimes with attached items like potions.

subject: QUEST list
text: The order follows in-game QUEST and does not necessarily match the order in which quests become available.

evidence.quote: 並びはゲーム内QUESTに準拠。必ずしも受注可能順とは一致しない。
evidence.translation: The order follows in-game QUEST and does not necessarily match the order in which quests become available.

evidence.translation: Teleport crystals sell for good prices, so people who do not use them can sell 1 to 2 per floor.

evidence.translation: The boss 大地に散った無数の命 appearing on floor 94 is too strong, please tell what weapon was used.

subject: 大地に散った無数の命
text: For 大地に散った無数の命 and Saw the Dragon, use Dual Blades The Eclipse, run away, and hit again repeatedly.

evidence.quote: 大地に散った無数の命や、竜を見たとかは、二刀流 ジ イクリプスうって、逃げてまた撃つ繰り返せばすぐ
evidence.translation: For 大地に散った無数の命 and Saw the Dragon, use Dual Blades The Eclipse, run away, and hit again repeatedly.

subject: 大地に散った無数の命
text: Pulling the boss of 大地に散った無数の命 to the bridge to the labyrinth lets you trap-kill it without taking damage because the path is narrow.

evidence.quote: 大地に散った無数の命出るボスは迷宮へ行く橋の所まで引っ張れば道が狭いので嵌め殺しノーダメージで倒せるよ。
evidence.translation: Pulling the boss of 大地に散った無数の命 to the bridge to the labyrinth lets you trap-kill it without taking damage because the path is narrow.

subject: アリ
text: The ant was defeated normally using Dual Blades.

evidence.quote: アリは二刀流で普通に倒したわ
evidence.translation: The ant was defeated normally using Dual Blades.

subject: アリ
object: straight-line attack: slide, charge, side-stick, sword skill
text: During a straight-line attack, slide, shift slightly more just in case, stick right to its side, and use a sword skill.

evidence.quote: 直線攻撃のときはスライドしてから念をいれてさらに少しズレて、真横に張り付いて奥義。
evidence.translation: During a straight-line attack, slide, shift slightly more just in case, stick right to its side, and use a sword skill.

subject: アリ

text: During an all-direction attack, run away just to the edge of the range, then use a sword skill.

evidence.quote: 全方位攻撃のときは範囲ギリギリまで逃げてから奥義。
evidence.translation: During an all-direction attack, run away just to the edge of the range, then use a sword skill.

subject: アリ

evidence.quote: 破壊光線はエグザクトで防ぐ。
evidence.translation: Block the destruction beam with Exact Guard.

subject: アリ

evidence.translation: If possible, parry normal attacks to raise the risk.
